messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads-up: on 2026-05-01 were changing billing cadence and adding a short burst exemption + a sustained-usage surcharge. Please hold external comms until the FAQ drops next week. :megaphone:

Evan (Ops): Clarify: does this change rate limits or just billing?

Nina (Finance): Just billing. No rate-limit algorithm changes. Key bullets:
- 24h burst exemption: one contiguous 24h window per 7-day rolling period per account will be exempt from overage billing (auto-applied).
- Sustained surcharge: triggers after 7 consecutive days above configured thresholds (>50% reserved throughput or >2x baseline).
- Invoice finalization moves to the 3rd business day; new line items will show credits/surcharges.

Kai (Product): How will this surface in the dashboard/invoice so AEs can explain?

Nina (Finance): Dashboard will show a soft warning at 70% quota. Invoices include line codes like BURST_EXEMPTION_CREDIT and SUSTAINED_SURCHARGE with short notes.

Rae (Support): Credits automatic? Disputes? Need templates.

Nina (Finance): Burst credits auto-apply. Disputed sustained charges go to billing ops for manual review (SLA 5 business days). Playbook + canned messages posted to #support-channels tomorrow.

BillingBot: Free credit phase-out note: accounts breaching sustained thresholds will see prorated credit adjustments starting 2026-06-01 with 30-day notice. Rule: FC-2026-06.

Evan (Ops): We'll add the banner and a /quota-sim endpoint for internal testing this week.

Kai (Product): Rollout timeline?

Nina (Finance): Internal docs: 2026-04-10. Early notices to affected customers: 2026-04-20. Public FAQ & blog: 2026-04-30. Enforcement dates: burst exemption 2026-05-01; credit phase-out 2026-06-01. Exceptions: negotiated enterprise terms and flagged pilots.

Rae (Support): Thanks  will prepare AE scripts once playbook is posted.
